title: New Advancements - Creative Edition
description:
Addon to mod New Advancements, 
which adds advancements for the game's creative mode
body:
- **This mod is an addon to mod New Advancements, it's optional, but it's better to install original mod.**
- **Adds advancements for a **_creative game mode_, for example, get a light block. This advancements are diversify the gameplay in creative.****
- _Mod is in beta, there will be more advancements in the future (if the mod becomes popular)._
